quests.name: Mushroom Picking
quests.hook: Gather a basket of mushrooms from the cave mouth before supper. What could possibly go wrong?

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The cave mouth is cool and smells of damp earth. You have gathered mushrooms on this ledge a hundred times.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The basket is nearly full when the mushrooms start moving.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You climb back into the evening light with a full basket and a new suspicion: the hill is awake.

quests.name: The Whispering Shaft
quests.hook: The shaft exhales a sound like whispered names. You go down to find out whose.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The shaft breathes out a sound like your own name, spoken by someone who has never met you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Rope in hand, you go down to meet the voice.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The whispering stops the moment the fight ends. Whatever was speaking will not say it again.

quests.name: Gloomcap Hollow
quests.hook: Where the light fails, the mushrooms glow — and so do the eyes watching them.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The tunnel opens into a hollow lit by pale mushrooms, each cap glowing like a held breath.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Between the caps, a dozen small lights blink — and none of them are mushrooms.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: With the guardians gone, the hollow's glow settles into something almost gentle.

quests.name: The Mycelium Warren
quests.hook: The tunnel walls are threaded with white filaments — and the filaments are listening.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: White filaments thread every wall of the warren, trembling whenever you speak.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The deeper you go, the less the tunnel feels like a passage and the more it feels like a throat.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You cut your way free, but the filaments have already carried word of you onward.

quests.name: The Capfather
quests.hook: Something enormous stirs where the warren turns deepest. The mushrooms were only its fingers.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The warren turns deepest here, and the floor trembles in a slow, patient rhythm.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: What you fought before were fingers. This is the hand.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The Capfather falls, and the warren goes quiet for the first time since you entered it.

quests.name: Down the Rootwell
quests.hook: The cave's roots drop away into black water. You climb down anyway.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The cave's roots plunge into black water, and the water is far deeper than the hill is tall.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You find a footing on the roots and climb down anyway.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You surface on the far bank, dripping and alive. The water keeps its secrets a little less tightly now.

quests.name: The Blindstream
quests.hook: A river runs under the hill, and it runs the wrong way.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: An underground river crosses your path, and it is flowing uphill, away from the sea.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The current has teeth, but it is the only way forward.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The stream carries the last of them away and resumes its impossible climb.

quests.name: Lantern Moss Grotto
quests.hook: The grotto glows with fireflies that should not exist this far underground.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The grotto glitters with fireflies, burning where no firefly has any business being.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Their light is warm. Too warm. It stings the air.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: When the last light dies, the grotto is only dark — and dark is a relief.

quests.name: The Fungal Throne
quests.hook: The warren widens into a hall, and at its end sits a throne that was grown, not built.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The tunnel opens into a hall, and at its end something grown, not built, serves as a throne.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Courtiers of spore and bark stand at attention. They have been waiting.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The throne stands empty, but the hall still hums — something above the court is listening.

quests.name: Mycelarch, the Rot Beneath
quests.hook: The throne is occupied. The thing on it has been waiting for someone to reach it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something occupies the throne at last: a pale crown of a creature, vast and patient.

intro.speaker: Mycelarch
intro.text: You came down and down. Good. I have been deciding what you will become.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The hall exhales, and the court comes for you all at once.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The Mycelarch comes apart like wet paper, and the hill's long grip finally loosens.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You climb toward daylight — and the surface world, which is about to show you its own rot.

quests.name: The Bramblegate
quests.hook: The road out of the valley is a wall of thorns now, and the thorns are moving.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You climb out of the caves into a valley that has grown over in a single season.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The road out is a wall of thorns now, and the thorns lean toward the sound of you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: To leave the valley, you will have to cut through.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You break through the bramblegate and take the first free breath of the open trail.

quests.name: Wolf of the Green Trail
quests.hook: Something has been eating the woodcutters' dogs, and it is not a dog.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The woodcutters' trail is strewn with collars and no dogs.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Whatever is hunting here wears moss for a coat.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The trail is safe enough to walk again — as far as the green line of trees.

quests.name: The Thornsinger's Grove
quests.hook: The grove hums, and every branch leans toward you like an ear.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The grove hums a single low note, and every branch leans in like an ear.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Follow the sound far enough and you will find the mouth making it.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The song stops. The branches straighten, as if embarrassed to have been caught listening.

quests.name: Hornets of the High Meadow
quests.hook: The meadow's hornets have grown, and they have started keeping prisoners.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The meadow hums with wings the length of your forearm, and the hum is organized.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Among the flowers hang paper cages, and the cages are not empty.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The meadow is quiet, the cages are broken, and whoever was inside has run for the treeline.

quests.name: The Thicket Tyrant
quests.hook: The thicket has a master. You can hear it breathing from the road.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You can hear the thicket breathing from the road — slow, wet, and patient.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The clearing it keeps is littered with splintered carts.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The breathing stops. The thicket is just a thicket again — for now.

quests.name: The Petrified Orchard
quests.hook: The orchard's trees turned to stone overnight. One thing in it didn't.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The orchard's trees turned to stone overnight, grey and smooth as river rock.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: One shape among them is still green, and it is still moving.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The stone grove stands silent, and the one living thing in it has been put to rest.

quests.name: Grove of the Hollow Stag
quests.hook: The stag's antlers are full of eyes, and every one is looking at you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A stag stands in the grove, its antlers heavy with eyes — and every one is trained on you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Around it, blooms and fawns move with an unnerving unison.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The eyes go dark one by one, and the grove returns to watching nothing at all.

quests.name: The Antlered King's Hunt
quests.hook: You are the quarry now, and the hunt has already begun.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The horns sound behind you, and the green closes in to cut off the path back.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You are the quarry now, and the hunt has already begun.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The huntsman falls and the horn falls silent. For this stretch of trail, the wilds have lost your scent.

quests.name: The Withering Bloom
quests.hook: Where the bloom passes, the green goes grey.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The path ahead is streaked grey, as if colour has been scraped out of it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The bloom that did it is close, and it is still spreading.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The grey stops advancing. Somewhere behind it, green will have to begin the slow work back.

quests.name: The Verdant Sovereign
quests.hook: The wilds have a king, and he does not want subjects. He wants soil.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The wilds end in a court of thorns, and at its centre sits a king of root and leaf.

intro.speaker: Verdant Sovereign
intro.text: You walked my roads and cut my children. I will keep you. As soil.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The court closes ranks, and the wilds come for you all at once.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The king topples, and the green recoils from the road as if burned.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The valley is open at last. Beyond it, the road runs down to a coast that smells of salt and rot.

quests.name: The Drowned Causeway
quests.hook: The old coast road is underwater now. So are the things that walk it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The valley road spills onto a coast that is half underwater, the old causeway drowned to the knee.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Things walk it still, up to their chests, patient as the tide.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You step down onto the flooded stones.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The causeway is clear for a stretch, and you keep to the dry crown of it while you can.

quests.name: Saltmarsh Stalker
quests.hook: The reeds move against the wind.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The saltmarsh reeds bow one way, and one patch bows the other — against the wind.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It knows you have noticed.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The reeds are still. You cross the marsh without another sound.

quests.name: The Gilded Reef
quests.hook: A reef of treasure and teeth, and the tide is going out.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A reef of gold and bones breaks the water, gleaming as the tide goes out.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The gleam is bait, and the tide will not stay out for long.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You pocket what floats and climb clear before the water returns to reclaim the rest.

quests.name: Tidehollow Grotto
quests.hook: The cave fills with the tide. You have until it does.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The grotto's mouth is already half-submerged, and the water is climbing.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You have until the tide finishes, and no longer.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You slip out with the water at your heels and stand breathing hard on the dry shingle.

quests.name: The Keeper of the Kelp
quests.hook: The kelp forest has a keeper, and it is very old.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The kelp forest sways in slow curtains, and something old keeps it pruned.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The keeper has been here far longer than the road has needed it.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The kelp parts of its own accord, and the way down the coast opens.

quests.name: The Sinking Village
quests.hook: The village is going under, one house at a time.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The village is going under, one house at a time, and the survivors have stopped saving furniture.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Half the houses are already drowned. Something down there is still busy.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: For tonight the village holds. You leave it the small mercy of a quiet tide.

quests.name: Blackwater Fen
quests.hook: The fen water is black and does not reflect you. That should worry you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The fen water is black and still, and it does not reflect you at all.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Things move beneath it that the water chooses not to show.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You come out the far side with both boots and all your fingers.

quests.name: The Lure-Lights
quests.hook: The lights on the water are beautiful. They are also a trap.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Lights drift across the water, beautiful and beckoning, and every sailor's chart warns of them.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The lights do not mind being known. They mind being ignored.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The lights wink out one by one, and the water is only water again.

quests.name: The Sunken Chapel
quests.hook: A chapel sank with its congregation. The bells still ring.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A chapel lies drowned in the shallows, its bell tower leaning beneath the surface.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The bells still ring, though no hand has touched the ropes in years.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The last bell note fades underwater. You leave the congregation to its rest.

quests.name: The Leviathan of the Deep
quests.hook: The coast has one master, and the tide goes where it is told.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The breakers pull back farther than any tide should, baring the sea floor for a mile.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something vast turns over in the deep, and the coast holds its breath.

intro.speaker: Leviathan
intro.text: The tide goes where I tell it. So will you.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The Leviathan sinks, and the sea rushes back to cover it — grudging, but obedient to nobody now.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The road turns north, where the air is already cold enough to sting.

quests.name: The Frostgate
quests.hook: The pass is closed by ice that grows while you watch.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The road north ends at a pass walled shut by ice — ice that creeps higher while you watch.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The frozen reaches begin here, and they begin with a gate.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You find the seam and start to climb.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You top the Frostgate and stand in a white world that has no intention of letting you through.

quests.name: Whiteout Pass
quests.hook: In the whiteout you will meet yourself. Do not trust it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The whiteout swallows the pass, and in it you see a figure walking toward you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It is wearing your coat. It has your limp. It is not you.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You leave your double behind in the snow, and try not to look back at it.

quests.name: The Frozen Lake
quests.hook: The lake is solid. Something big is sleeping underneath it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The lake is solid white, and far beneath the ice something huge is sleeping.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Every step you take sends a crack crawling toward it.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You reach the far shore just as the first long groan runs the length of the lake.

quests.name: Rime Hollow
quests.hook: Every breath hangs in the air here, frozen mid-cloud.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The hollow is so cold that every breath hangs in the air, frozen mid-cloud.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something in the hollow breathes too, and its breath hangs longest.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The cold eases by a single degree as you walk out. It counts as a welcome.

quests.name: The Ice-Warden
quests.hook: The Warden keeps the cold in — or keeps something else in with it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: An ice-bound warden stands at the gate to the high reaches, its hounds chained at its feet.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It keeps the cold in. What it keeps in with the cold is another question.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The Warden breaks and its hounds fall with it. Whatever it guarded has one fewer lock.

quests.name: The Glasswood
quests.hook: The trees are glass, and they are full of trapped things.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The trees here froze into glass, and every one of them is full of trapped shapes.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Some of the shapes are still moving.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You pass through the glasswood and leave its prisoners to their slow, glittering vigil.

quests.name: The Howling Glacier
quests.hook: The glacier howls, and the howl is getting closer.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The glacier howls across the valley, a sound like a wolf with the lungs of a mountain.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The howl is closer than it was a minute ago.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The howling stops. The glacier is only ice again, and ice is quiet.

quests.name: The Cave of Frozen Birds
quests.hook: Hundreds of birds hang frozen in the cave, and one of them just blinked.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Hundreds of birds hang frozen in the cave, wings spread, caught mid-flight and mid-song.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: One of them blinks. Then another.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The flock falls, and the cave is still. You do not look too closely at the ceiling.

quests.name: The Wintering Court
quests.hook: The frozen court holds session, and the courtiers have been waiting a very long time.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The frozen court holds session in a hall of clear ice, its courtiers posed for an age.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: They have been waiting a very long time for a visitor to acknowledge.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The court finally adjourns. You take the throne room's far door without ceremony.

quests.name: The Hoarfrost Queen
quests.hook: Winter is not a season here. It is a ruler, and she has noticed you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The ice hall opens onto a throne of frost, and upon it sits winter itself, wearing a crown.

intro.speaker: Hoarfrost Queen
intro.text: Every breath you have spent here was borrowed. I have come to collect.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Her guard closes the doors behind you.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The Hoarfrost Queen shatters into snow, and for the first time the cold has no master.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The thaw will be slow, but it has begun. South of here, the air already smells of ash.

quests.name: Ashfall Field
quests.hook: Ash falls like grey snow, and beneath it the ground is warm.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Ash falls like grey snow over a field that should be green.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Beneath the ash the ground is warm, and it is warmer the further you walk.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The Emberwilds greet you with a summer that never ended.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The field is quiet. The ash keeps falling, patient as a season.

quests.name: The Cinder Wood
quests.hook: The forest burned years ago and simply never stopped.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The forest burned years ago and simply never stopped burning.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Every trunk is a torch that has been holding its flame for a decade.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You leave the cinder wood standing, still burning, still patient.

quests.name: Magma Shallows
quests.hook: The shallow water is boiling, and something is swimming in it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The shallows are boiling, steam curling off water that should be cool.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something long moves under the surface, unbothered by the heat.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The shallows settle to a simmer, and whatever swam in them swims no longer.

quests.name: The Boiling Spring
quests.hook: The spring runs hot enough to strip bone, and something lives in it happily.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The spring runs hot enough to strip bone, and something lives in it happily.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It surfaces to look at you the way a cook looks at a pot.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You put the spring's keeper down and step back from its scalding water.

quests.name: The Forgebeast
quests.hook: The forge never stopped, and neither did what feeds it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: An ancient forge still roars in the hillside, though no smith has worked it in centuries.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something feeds it. Something is still feeding it.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The forge dims for the first time in living memory. The hillside goes dark and cold.

quests.name: The Obsidian Stair
quests.hook: A stair of black glass climbs into the smoke, and something is climbing down.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A stair of black glass climbs into the smoke, sharp as a blade.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something is climbing down it, and it is in no hurry.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You take the stair upward, and the smoke swallows you without complaint.

quests.name: The Ember Monkeys
quests.hook: The ember monkeys stole your supplies and are laughing about it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The ember monkeys have your pack, your rope, and your lunch, and they are laughing.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: They want you to chase them. You will.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You recover the pack and most of the lunch. The monkeys watch you go, offended.

quests.name: The Cinder Carnival
quests.hook: Someone built a carnival in the lava fields, and the rides are still running.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A carnival stands in the lava fields, its rides turning with no one to ride them.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The ringmaster is still taking tickets.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The rides grind to a halt. The carnival is finally closed.

quests.name: The Caldera Rim
quests.hook: The rim is the only solid ground for miles, and it is cracking.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The caldera rim is the only solid ground for miles, and it is cracking underfoot.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Guards patrol its edge, keeping watch on the drop.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The rim holds, for now, and you cross before the mountain changes its mind.

quests.name: Pyroclast, the Mountain's Heart
quests.hook: The mountain has a heart, and it has been beating for a thousand years. Tonight it wakes.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You climb down into the caldera, and the mountain's beat is loud enough to feel in your teeth.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It has been beating for a thousand years. Tonight it wakes.

intro.speaker: Pyroclast
intro.text: You will make good fuel.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: Pyroclast collapses into its own crater, and the mountain's heart goes still.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The Emberwilds cool behind you. Ahead, storm clouds stack above the peaks.

quests.name: Thunderclap Ridge
quests.hook: Every step on the ridge throws a spark, and something is walking the same path.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Every step along the ridge throws a spark, and the air tastes of metal.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something else is walking the same path, a little behind you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The Storm Peaks do not announce themselves. They ambush.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The ridge falls quiet. For now, nothing walks it but you and the static.

quests.name: The Static Meadow
quests.hook: The grass stands on end, and it stands on end because something is near.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The meadow grass stands on end, and it stands on end because something is near.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The something is grazing, and it has charged fur.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The meadow relaxes, blade by blade, as the charge drains out of the air.

quests.name: Voltstag's Herd
quests.hook: The herd moves as one animal, and one animal is looking at you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The herd moves as one animal across the plateau, hooves throwing sparks.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: One animal has stopped, and it is looking at you.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The herd scatters into the static, and the plateau belongs to the wind again.

quests.name: The Charged Chasm
quests.hook: The chasm hums with current, and the bridge across it is a single copper wire.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The chasm hums with current, and the only bridge is a single copper wire.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something is weaving more of that wire across the gap.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You cross the chasm and leave the wire humming behind you.

quests.name: The Stormherd Alpha
quests.hook: The herd has an alpha, and it has been saving the charge for you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The herd has an alpha, bigger than the rest and crackling at the mane.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It has been saving the charge in its horns. For you.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The alpha goes down, and its herd scatters, unled and harmless.

quests.name: The Lightning Stair
quests.hook: A stair of frozen bolts climbs into the clouds, and it does not look safe.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A stair of frozen lightning climbs into the clouds, each step a bolt caught mid-strike.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It does not look safe, and it is the only way up.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You reach the clouds, and the stair holds behind you, still frozen, still dangerous.

quests.name: The Besieged Beacon Tower
quests.hook: The tower's beacon has been dark for days. Someone took it, and someone is holding it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The beacon tower is dark, its fire stolen days ago.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The thief still holds the tower, and the light with it.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The beacon burns again, and the coast will see it, and know the tower stands.

quests.name: The Copper Aviary
quests.hook: A cage of copper wire hangs from the peak, and inside it, birds of lightning.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A cage of copper wire hangs from the peak, humming with trapped light.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Inside it, birds made of lightning beat against the bars.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The cage falls open, and the birds streak away into the clouds like released arrows.

quests.name: The Conduit Spire
quests.hook: The spire drinks the storm and stores it. There's a sound like a held breath.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The spire drinks the storm and stores it, and the air around it sounds like a held breath.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Its warden does not intend to exhale.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The spire discharges into the sky, and the held breath finally releases.

quests.name: Skybreaker, the Storm's Crown
quests.hook: The storm has a crown, and the crown has a keeper. The keeper is coming down.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The storm over the peaks has a crown, a ring of light that turns above the clouds.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The crown has a keeper, and the keeper is coming down to meet you.

intro.speaker: Skybreaker
intro.text: The storm answers to me. You will answer to the storm.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: Skybreaker falls, and the storm breaks apart into ordinary rain.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The peaks are clean under a washed sky. Far below, a quarry gate stands open.

quests.name: The Quarry Gate
quests.hook: The quarry closed decades ago. Today the gate is open.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The quarry closed decades ago, its gate rusted shut and its road grassed over.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Today the gate is open, and the road is swept clean.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You go in because someone wants you to, and because you have to.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The gate stands open behind you, and the dark of the quarry answers nothing yet.

quests.name: The Stonefall Gallery
quests.hook: The gallery ceilings shift every night, as if the mountain is chewing.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The gallery ceilings shift every night, stone grinding on stone, as if the mountain is chewing.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The dust in the air is fresh, and the ceiling is lower than it was.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You pass through before the next shift, and the ceiling grinds shut behind you.

quests.name: The Boulder Run
quests.hook: A rolling boulder has run this track for a century, and it has learned to aim.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A boulder has rolled this track for a century, wearing a groove deep into the stone.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It has learned to aim.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The boulder runs on without you, and the track falls silent for the first time in a hundred years.

quests.name: The Termite Halls
quests.hook: The halls were carved by things with appetites bigger than their bodies.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The halls are carved smooth and warm, and the marks are not tool-marks but teeth-marks.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The things that made them are still hungry.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The halls are quiet and the carving stops. The mountain will keep its shape a while longer.

quests.name: The Quarry Tyrant
quests.hook: Something runs the quarry. The workers left in a hurry and never came back.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The quarry's tools are scattered where they fell, and the workers left in a hurry.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something runs the quarry now, and it does not like visitors.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The quarry falls quiet. The tools stay where they lie, and you leave them there.

quests.name: The Undergate Foundry
quests.hook: Below the quarry is a foundry, and its furnaces are still warm.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Below the quarry, a foundry glows, its furnaces warm though no hand has fed them.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something keeps them lit.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The foundry dims, and for the first time the undergate is only dark.

quests.name: The Court of Standing Stones
quests.hook: The stones were set in a circle long ago. Tonight they have turned slightly.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The standing stones were set in a circle long ago, and they are no longer quite in a circle.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Tonight they have turned, and they are turning still.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The stones settle back into their ring, and the ground stops humming beneath them.

quests.name: The Grinding Deep
quests.hook: The deep grinds its teeth, and the sound never stops.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The deep grinds its teeth below the foundry, a sound that never stops.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The sound is made of stone against stone, and something is driving it.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The grinding stops. The deep is quiet, and quiet is what a mine should be.

quests.name: The Earthheart Vault
quests.hook: The vault door is a mountain's face, and the mountain is frowning.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The vault door is carved as a mountain's face, and the mountain is frowning.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Its guardians have not accepted a key in a very long time.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The vault stands open behind you, and something deeper still has noticed.

quests.name: Terravore, the Root of Mountains
quests.hook: The mountain's roots have a heart. Break it, and the mountain falls.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The mountain's roots knot into a heart, vast and slow, beating in the dark below the vault.

intro.speaker: Terravore
intro.text: Root me out and the mountain falls on you. Leave, and I keep beating.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You raise your weapon anyway.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: Terravore splits, and the mountain shudders but holds. The deep is quiet at last.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You climb toward the surface, and the first thing you smell is graves.

quests.name: The Grave Road
quests.hook: The road to the citadel is lined with graves, and the graves are opening.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The road to the citadel is lined with graves, and the graves are opening.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Whatever was buried here was buried facing the citadel, and it is climbing out to face it again.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The Shadowed Marches begin at the first open grave.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The graves frown shut behind you, and the road runs on into the mist.

quests.name: The Mist of the Marches
quests.hook: The mist is thick enough to walk on. It is also walking.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The mist is thick enough to walk on, and it is walking.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something in it has learned your shape.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You come out of the mist, and behind you the fog closes like a door.

quests.name: The Gallows Orchard
quests.hook: The orchard's fruit hangs heavy, and none of it is fruit.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The orchard's branches hang heavy with fruit, and none of it is fruit.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The keeper tends the harvest with a patience that has outlived the village.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The orchard is quiet, and the branches are lighter than they have been in years.

quests.name: The Crypt of Candles
quests.hook: The crypt is lit by candles that gutter when you lie.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The crypt is lit by candles that gutter when you lie.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You have nothing to hide. The candles gutter anyway.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The last candle burns steady as you climb the crypt's stair.

quests.name: The Pale Rider
quests.hook: Something rides the march on a horse of smoke, and it is looking for a mount.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something rides the march on a horse of smoke, and it is looking for a mount.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It has decided that you look like a good one.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The rider comes apart into mist, and its smoke-horse with it. The march is riderless.

quests.name: The Legion of the Hollow Choir
quests.hook: You can hear them singing from a mile off. You should not be able to.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You can hear them singing from a mile off, and you should not be able to.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The choir holds its note as you approach, as though waiting for a voice to join.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The choir has one fewer voice, and the march is a little quieter for it.

quests.name: The Widow's Court
quests.hook: The widow holds court in the dark, and her courtiers have all stopped moving.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The widow holds court in the dark, and her courtiers have all stopped moving.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The widow has not.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The court disperses into the shadows, and the widow does not follow.

quests.name: The Hunger Below
quests.hook: Something under the march is always hungry, and it has smelled you for miles.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something under the march is always hungry, and it has smelled you for miles.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It has been saving room.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The hunger is quiet now. It will be hungry again, but not tonight.

quests.name: The Black Cathedral
quests.hook: The cathedral was built to something, and it is still open for worship.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The black cathedral was built to something, and it is still open for worship.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The congregation never left.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The cathedral falls silent. You leave its doors open behind you.

quests.name: Umbragore, the Shadow Sovereign
quests.hook: The marches have a sovereign, and he has been expecting you since the grave road.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The marches end at a court of ash, and on its throne sits a sovereign of shadow.

intro.speaker: Umbragore
intro.text: I felt you open my first grave. I have been expecting you since.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: His court rises around you.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: Umbragore dissolves into the dark he ruled, and the marches lose their sovereign.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: Beyond the ash court, a ridge of bones climbs into the clouds — and it is breathing.

quests.name: The Spine Road
quests.hook: The road rides a dragon's spine, and the dragon is not as dead as it looks.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The road rides a dragon's spine, vertebra by vertebra, up out of the marches.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The dragon is not as dead as it looks. The road is not as safe as it seems.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You begin the climb.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The spine shifts underfoot, and you move on before it finishes waking.

quests.name: Scales on the Ridge
quests.hook: The ridge sheds scales like leaves, and each one is bigger than a shield.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The ridge sheds scales like leaves, each one bigger than a shield.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something above is scratching itself against the rocks.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You pass beneath the ridge untouched, and the scales keep falling behind you.

quests.name: The Hoard of Names
quests.hook: A hoard of coins, and every coin has a name on it. Yours is in there somewhere.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A hoard of coins fills the cavern, and every coin carries a name.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It takes you a moment to understand that one of them is yours.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The hoard is scattered, and somewhere in it your name is no longer the freshest.

quests.name: The Wyrmsblood Fen
quests.hook: The fen runs red where the old wyrms bled, and it never dried.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The fen runs red where the old wyrms bled, and it has never dried.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The blood is still warm, and it is still guarded.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You cross the fen and wash the red from your boots on the far bank.

quests.name: The Wyrmling Broodmother
quests.hook: The eggs are hatching, and the mother is right behind you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The eggs are hatching, a whole clutch of them, and the mother is right behind you.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: She is not happy about the company.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The broodmother falls, and the clutch goes cold. The spine groans its displeasure.

quests.name: The Cradle of Coils
quests.hook: The cradle is a pit of coils, and they are all awake.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The cradle is a pit of coils, and they are all awake.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It is not a nest. It is a mouth with many tongues.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The coils slacken, and the cradle is only a pit again.

quests.name: The Broken Sky Temple
quests.hook: The temple was built to hold the sky up, its roof is gone, and the sky is falling.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The sky temple was built to hold the sky up. Its roof is gone, and the sky is falling.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The wardens still stand their posts.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The temple's wardens fall, and for a moment the sky stops falling.

quests.name: The Elder Wyrm's Court
quests.hook: The elder wyrm holds court, and its courtiers are the bones of everyone who has ever visited.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The elder wyrm holds court in a hall of bones — the bones of everyone who has ever visited.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It would like to add yours to the collection.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The elder wyrm falls from its dais, and its court has a new centrepiece.

quests.name: The Last Egg
quests.hook: One egg remains, and it is warm. Something wants it back.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: One egg remains in the whole spine, and it is warm.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Something wants it back badly enough to be waiting.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You leave the last egg where it lies, and walk on.

quests.name: Voragrim, the Dragon's Spine
quests.hook: The spine is not a road. It is a dragon, and it has been waiting for the citadel's call.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The spine is not a road. It is a dragon, and it has been waiting for the citadel's call.

intro.speaker: Voragrim
intro.text: The Dark Lord calls. You climbed my back to answer him. Fool.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The mountain beneath you stands up.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: Voragrim falls, and the spine finally goes still — a ridge of bones and nothing more.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: Ahead, across a plain of ash, the citadel's gates are already open.

quests.name: The Citadel Gates
quests.hook: The gates open as you approach. That is not a welcome; it is a dare.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The citadel fills the horizon, black against the ash plain.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The gates open as you approach. That is not a welcome; it is a dare.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You walk in.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The gates close behind you with a sound like a held breath, and the citadel has you.

quests.name: The Ash Courtyard
quests.hook: The courtyard is ankle-deep in ash, and the ash remembers being people.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The courtyard is ankle-deep in ash, and the ash remembers being people.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It reaches for your ankles as you cross.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You cross the courtyard and leave the ash to its remembering.

quests.name: The Hall of Broken Oaths
quests.hook: Every oath sworn in this hall broke, and the hall kept the pieces.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Every oath sworn in this hall broke, and the hall kept the pieces.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The pieces are still here, and they are still angry.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The hall falls quiet, its oaths finally unkept and unguarded.

quests.name: The Screaming Gallery
quests.hook: The paintings scream. Do not look at them.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The paintings scream. Do not look at them.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: You look. Of course you look.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: You leave the gallery with your ears ringing and your name uncarved.

quests.name: The Warden of Nine Locks
quests.hook: Nine locks guard the inner keep. One warden guards the locks.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Nine locks guard the inner keep, each one a door in its own right.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: One warden guards them all, and it has never lost a key.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The nine locks stand open, and the inner keep is one door closer.

quests.name: The Throne Antechamber
quests.hook: The dark lord's throne is through the next door, and the antechamber is full of everyone who reached it first.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The throne is through the next door, and the antechamber is full of everyone who reached it first.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: None of them ever opened that door.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The antechamber empties, and the throne door stands before you.

quests.name: The Court of Masks
quests.hook: Everyone at court wears a mask, and none of the masks are empty.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Everyone at court wears a mask, and none of the masks are empty.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: One of them has been waiting for a face like yours.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The masks fall empty to the floor, and the court is only furniture.

quests.name: The Hollow Chancellor
quests.hook: The dark lord's chancellor is a hollow suit of armor, and something is wearing it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The dark lord's chancellor is a hollow suit of armour, and something is wearing it.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The something would rather you did not look inside.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The armour clatters empty to the floor. The throne room doors are unbarred.

quests.name: The Dark Lord's Shadow
quests.hook: The dark lord's shadow got here first, and it is bigger than he is.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The dark lord's shadow got here first, and it is bigger than he is.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: It has been wearing his shape for a long time, and it does not want to give it back.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The shadow comes apart, and the throne room dims to a single lit door.

quests.name: The Dark Lord's Inner Chamber
quests.hook: The door closes behind you, the throne turns, and the dark lord has been waiting a very long time.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The door closes behind you, and the throne turns.

intro.speaker: The Dark Lord
intro.text: You have walked my whole world to stand here. I will make it worth the trip.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The dark lord rises, and the room goes cold.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The dark lord falls, and the citadel exhales a century of held breath.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: Dawn breaks over the ash plain for the first time anyone can remember.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: The Long Dark is over. The road home is, at last, only a road.
